summary: @servicetitan/form-state 41.3.1 preinstall dropper fetches Bun runtime and executes obfuscated payload
details: package.json declares scripts.preinstall = 'node setup.mjs'. setup.mjs is itself obfuscated (hex-mangled identifiers such as _0x488df8, _0x52943e; inline per-function string tables) and, on npm install, downloads a Bun runtime zip from github.com/oven-sh/bun releases, extracts the bun binary, chmods it executable, and execFileSyncs the sibling file math_init.js under it. math_init.js is a single-line ~727KB blob using rotated char-code/string-array obfuscation (WV8StW shuffle) and hex-mangled identifiers to hide its runtime strings and destinations. Executing an opaque ~727KB payload via a freshly-downloaded alternate language runtime at install time is unrelated to the package's declared purpose as a React form-state helper and matches the alternate-runtime-dropper attack pattern. The payload runs unconditionally under `npm install`, yielding arbitrary code execution on the installer's machine.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
